text: **Constitutional AI**, Anthropic's approach and the one referenced back in Chapter 1's discussion of Claude, modifies this recipe: instead of relying entirely on case-by-case human feedback for every training signal, a model is trained against a written set of principles, a "constitution", critiquing and revising its own draft responses against those principles before the final training step.
